content:
I have (or rather adopted from Anatole) a series of PRs that characterize BigO in terms of seminorms in locally convex spaces. This is crucially needed to calculate derivatives with values in LCTVS (which in turn is used to solve PDEs).
These PRs have been sitting around for a bit and it would be great if some would have a look at them.
#42676 (this is the final one of Anatole's work) adds characterizations of IsLittleOTVS in terms of seminorms
I've assigned myself to the last one. I'll have a look today
